#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long solve(int n, long long mod) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long previous_result = 17;
    long long current_result = 17;
    int max_size = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int switch_flag = 1;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp_table(2, vector<long long>(max_size + 1, 0));
    dp_table[0][0] = 1;
    dp_table[0][1] = 2;
    dp_table[0][2] = 2;
    dp_table[0][3] = 1;

    for (int m = 4; m < n; ++m) {
        long long pair_total = (long long)m * (m - 1) / 2;
        current_result = (long long)(m + 1) * previous_result;
        long long cum_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            cum_sum += dp_table[switch_flag ^ 1][i];
            cum_sum %= mod;
            dp_table[switch_flag][i] = cum_sum;
        }
        for (int i = m; i <= pair_total / 2; ++i) {
            cum_sum += dp_table[switch_flag ^ 1][i];
            cum_sum -= dp_table[switch_flag ^ 1][i - m];
            cum_sum %= mod;
            if (cum_sum < 0) cum_sum += mod;
            dp_table[switch_flag][i] = cum_sum;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= pair_total / 2; ++i) {
            dp_table[switch_flag][pair_total - i] = dp_table[switch_flag][i];
        }
        long long total_accum = 0;
        for (long long i = 0; i < pair_total; ++i) {
            long long temp_sum = 0;
            long long start_idx = max((long long)1, -pair_total + i + m + 2);
            for (long long j = start_idx; j <= m; ++j) {
                long long index = m + 2 - j + i;
                if (index >= 0 && index <= pair_total) {
                    temp_sum += j * dp_table[switch_flag][index];
                }
            }
            total_accum += dp_table[switch_flag][i];
            total_accum %= mod;
            temp_sum %= mod;
            current_result += (temp_sum * total_accum) % mod;
            current_result %= mod;
        }
        previous_result = current_result;
        switch_flag ^= 1;
    }
    return current_result % mod;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    long long mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    cout << solve(n, mod) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
